central_findings: Uniform sampling without replacement of fixed binary-labeled IDs does not require physical independence of the rows or underlying observations.
Finite residual-policy evaluation and marginal calibration are distinct; the latter additionally needs role-invariant panel scores and justified allocation symmetry.
Physical independence of Li groups is not a mathematical prerequisite solely for a declared ID-weighted archive-label target, but panel membership must be frozen if it defines the endpoint.

Grouping/overlap evidence remains material for distinct-specimen/material/source assertions, fresh holdout and training leakage, source lineage, scientific target interpretation and unique-evidence cost accounting.
No current Li readiness, acquisition route, scientific protocol or fresh evaluation population is established. Dated reports are not silently updated using unreviewed artifacts.
No retuning or reinterpretation of exposed MPEA/JARVIS results is authorized or recommended.
